headline: A federal law renames a Brooklyn, New York Postal Service facility after Major Robert Odell Owens.
what_it_does: This law names the Postal Service facility at 1234 Saint Johns Place in Brooklyn, New York, the "Major Robert Odell Owens Post Office." It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or the rules for mail. The law was signed on December 14, 2018.
when_it_takes_effect: December 14, 2018, the date it was enacted.
